pitch: A media magnate wants a parliamentary microphone and a consultant whose conscience has an off switch.
candidateBlurb: A fictional proprietor of several mutually outraged newspapers. Treats the truth as a premium subscription tier. Welcomes ruthless operators, but has a ready-made headline blaming them if anything comes to light.

objectives.label: Keep the proprietor composed (morale at least 25)

keepMessage: Every Voss paper calls it a historic triumph. Your invoice is filed under miscellaneous editorial necessities.
sackMessage: The morning headline reads CONSULTANT LETS DOWN TRUSTING CANDIDATE. You recognise the photograph from your staff pass.

requires.label: Ruthlessness 85 — Voss only hires operators who have crossed almost every line
